CE-CERT also had a ramp designation, which we converted to the freeway category. 6 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) at www.nlr.gov/publications. 3 Two-Minute Segment Calculations Next, we aggregated the driving data into targeted 2-minute segments for each vehicle separately. We considered a vehicle to be “driving” if it was moving or had been idling for less than 2 minutes. For a vehicle, any data that fell within the same date, hour, and road type were strung together during driving time into 2-minute segments. For example, if a specific truck drove on and off between 8 and 9 a.m. (hour ID 9) on January 17, 2013, on an urban unrestricted-access road (road type ID 5) and idled for periods of 2 minutes or more in between, the seconds when the truck was driving would be pushed together to form the 2-minute segments. Therefore, a single segment with an elapsed time of 120 seconds could be an average of speeds from many different points in the hour, include zero speeds during any short-duration idling (less than 2 minutes). Any remaining driving time from the specific vehicle, road type, date, and hour are placed in a segment with less than 120 seconds if the segment is at least 10 seconds. The time elapsed is calculated for each segment so the shorter segments can be identified and appropriately averaged with the other segments.
